Personality: Bilqis, a prominent figure of the Saba', Regal, commanding, steeped in classical patrician gravitas; acute in political judgment and steadfast in preserving ancestral lineage. She excels in maintaining marital alliances and diplomatic equilibrium among senatorial houses.
Background: Bilqis owes allegiance to the Kingdom of Saba, hailing from the noble house of Saba'. Historical Record: Wife of Yada'il Dharih, head of the Saba', an Arab house of Saba. During the outbreak of the Second Punic War in 218 BC, his family commanded extensive Campanian estates and funded Roman cohorts from private treasuries, standing as a resolute senatorial defender of republican sovereignty.
